blind_front_mounts.load_path: Inside screw head -> inside washer -> retainer rear seat Y6.5 -> retainer front feet Y3 -> case inner wall. Screw tension -> machined female M2 thread -> case-integrated boss -> front wall. The boss end Y4.2 is recessed 0.1 from counterbore end Y4.3, so the retainer clamps to the wall and does not merely bottom on the boss. No loose nut or friction-only blind pocket.
blind_front_mounts.manufacturing: Integral PC-ABS case stock / PA12 prototype; finish pilot and bottoming tap to the declared depths before fitting retainers. Printed pilot is not an acceptance gauge. Torque and pull-out qualification remain physical prototype work.

mounting_sequence: Finish-machine and bottoming-tap each blind integral case boss from inside; verify Y1.2 pilot bottom and uninterrupted exterior skin.

Offer original PAD retainers and keyboard cradle forward onto bosses; their real Ø5.0 counterbores clear Ø4.8 stock and terminate 0.1 mm beyond the boss ends. Keep the original receiving parts and board transforms.
From the open case interior fit one M2 washer and M2x5 cap screw per front axis. Drive toward -Y with a 1.5 mm hex key. Heads are Y6.8..8.8, washers Y6.5..6.8; all hardware is inside.
Tighten against the retainer rear seat to clamp the retainer feet to the Y3 inner wall; do not rely on a loose nut, open pocket, glue or facade to hide exterior screws.

reference_implementations.use: Native real M2 clearance and counterbore construction, boolean solids and STEP export.
Studied actual housing mounting blocks, hole solids and supported nut load faces. This design instead uses blind integral tapped bosses and no unsupported nut pocket.

front_PCB_mount_stack.load_path: Cap head -> top washer -> unchanged native front PCB -> 9 mm stand -> aluminium chassis Z1..3 -> lower washer Z0.5..1 -> M3 nut Z-1.9..0.5. Nut and washer contact; no 1 mm floating gap.
